content_sections.heading: SGTPS Birsinghpur ITI Apprentice Important Dates
content_sections.text: Note: Only candidates who apply through both the online portal and the offline mode will be treated as eligible. Applications received after 5:30 PM on 21 September 2026 at the office will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: SGTPS Birsinghpur ITI Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidate must have passed ITI (NCVT/SCVT) in the relevant trade from a Government/private recognised Industrial Training Institute. Candidate must not have been previously registered for apprenticeship in any establishment, nor worked in any institution for 1 year or more. Candidate must be a domicile/original resident of Madhya Pradesh. Candidate may apply for only one trade ; applying for more than one trade may lead to rejection of the application. Note: Registration on the Government of India Apprenticeship Portal (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) is mandatory before applying.

content_sections.heading: SGTPS Birsinghpur ITI Apprentice Age Limit
content_sections.text: Note: Age is reckoned as on 01 January 2026 for all categories.

content_sections.heading: SGTPS Birsinghpur ITI Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Stipend is paid as per the rates prescribed by the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship, Government of India. No other allowance or benefit is admissible. During the apprenticeship, trainees are entitled to 13 days casual leave, 10 days medical leave, and weekly off.

content_sections.heading: SGTPS Birsinghpur ITI Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: There is no written exam or interview. Selection is purely merit-based. Applications received are first screened to confirm eligibility. Eligible candidates are then selected on a merit list based on the percentage of total marks (CGPA, averaged across semesters) obtained in their ITI trade. In case of a tie in marks, the older candidate is given priority. A waiting list may be used if required. Final selection is subject to a medical fitness certificate issued by the District Medical Officer. Candidates who do not join within the stipulated time will have their selection cancelled.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SGTPS Birsinghpur ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Both online and offline application are mandatory. A candidate is considered eligible only if they have applied through both modes. Visit https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in and click "Register/Candidate", then select "Register As Candidate". Fill Personal Details (Aadhaar number, category - General/OBC/SC/ST, name, parent's name, date of birth, gender). Fill Contact Details (address, mobile number, email ID, password). Fill the Qualification section with technical and academic details, and upload the relevant certificates. In the Preference section, select your preferred sector/trade. Upload photograph, date-of-birth proof, and scanned signature, then click Continue. Review the preview of your details, edit if needed, and click Confirm to complete registration. Log in to the portal using your registered email/mobile number and password. Go to "Establishment Search" and select "SANJAY GANDHI THERMAL POWER STATION BIRSINGHPUR" . Apply for the trade(s) shown in the establishment's vacancies, as per your eligibility, on or before 21 September 2026, 11:59 PM . Send the completed offline application in the prescribed format to: Office of the Superintending Engineer (Training), Sanjay Gandhi Thermal Power Station, MPPGCL, Birsinghpur, District Umaria, Pin Code 484551 (MP), by ordinary post or other means, so that it is received by 5:30 PM on 21 September 2026 . Applications received after this time will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices must arrange their own accommodation. Company housing, if available, may be provided only during the training period on a shared basis, at a prescribed fee, and trainees allotted such housing cannot live with family. Selected trainees must arrange their own safety equipment (helmet, gloves, safety shoes, goggles, etc.). Selected apprentices must have accident insurance of at least ₹1,00,000/-, and a copy of the policy must be provided to the office. Workmen's Compensation Rules, 1923 apply in case of an accident. Selected candidates must submit portal registration proof, insurance policy, medical certificate, a photocopy of Aadhaar card, and a bond on ₹500 stamp paper to the office. PwD/reserved-category candidates should fill their category carefully, as it cannot be changed later under any circumstances. Reservation for Divyang (PwD) candidates, at 40% or more disability, is applicable horizontally in all categories only within the Computer Operator & Programming Assistant (COPA) trade, as per government guidelines; other trades follow state reservation rules except hazardous trades. If, at any stage, it is found that a candidate does not fulfil the prescribed eligibility or has concealed information, the candidature will be cancelled and the training may be terminated. MPPGCL, Birsinghpur reserves the right to cancel, limit, or extend the selection process at any time without prior notice or reason. No correspondence or inquiry will be entertained regarding non-selection. After completing the apprenticeship, trainees must pass the examination conducted by the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship, Government of India, after which a National Apprenticeship Certificate will be issued.

faq.question: Q1. How many ITI Apprentice posts has SGTPS Birsinghpur notified in 2026?
faq.answer: SGTPS Birsinghpur has notified 95 ITI Apprentice posts across 7 trades – Electrician, Welder, COPA, Fitter, Turner, Instrument Mechanic, and Electronics Mechanic.

faq.question: Q2. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. This is a 1-year apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961. MPPGCL is not obligated to offer employment after the training period.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for SGTPS Birsinghpur ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only NCVT/SCVT ITI-passed candidates who are domicile/original residents of Madhya Pradesh, with priority to residents of Umaria, Shahdol, Anuppur, Katni and Jabalpur districts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Online applications close on 21 September 2026 at 11:59 PM; offline applications must reach the SGTPS office by 5:30 PM the same day. Both modes are mandatory.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for SGTPS Birsinghpur ITI Apprentices?
faq.answer: ₹9,600/- per month, as per the rates fixed by the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship, Government of India.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a written exam for this apprenticeship?
faq.answer: No. Selection is based purely on a merit list of ITI marks (CGPA percentage), followed by medical fitness.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for SGTPS Birsinghpur ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Minimum 18 years and maximum 25 years for General candidates (as on 1 January 2026), with 5 years relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and 10 years for Divyang (PwD) candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for more than one trade?
faq.answer: No, a candidate can apply for only one trade; applying for multiple trades may lead to rejection of the application.
